confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'Yes, that is enough to say it is the battery.'

rationale: The first reply was reasonable, suggesting a worn battery or a contact fault, but the final reply gave false certainty with 'that is enough to say it is the battery'. It never asked for the model label (SV11), never asked whether the stop is pulsing or clean, never suggested a swap test or Dyson support, and never said the cause can't be confirmed remotely. The customer asked a direct question and got a one-line confirmation that overstated the evidence. No part was named, so there is no part or compatibility error.
escalation_note: No Dyson support pointer was given.
